name: EKODI Sustainable Evolution Model
currentGenerationLabel: Integrated Platform moving toward Capability Platform
principle: Grow by verified need, preserve user and workspace sovereignty, and expand cost only after value is proven.

generations.name: Service Collection
generations.goal: Independent services exist and deliver value.

generations.name: Integrated Platform
generations.goal: Shared identity, workspace, admin, core contracts and guarded operations unify the ecosystem.

generations.name: Capability Platform
generations.goal: Capabilities become canonical contracts and compatible implementations can be selected without redefining workspace identity.

generations.name: Intent OS
generations.goal: User intent is resolved into authorized capabilities and orchestrated workflows.

generations.name: Agentic OS
generations.goal: Multiple bounded agents collaborate through governed capabilities, tools and approval gates.

generations.name: Federated Ecosystem
generations.goal: Independent organizations and platforms interoperate while retaining identity, data and policy sovereignty.

generations.name: Self-Evolving Ecosystem
generations.goal: Evidence-driven evolution intelligence recommends and safely experiments within delegated limits; governance remains authoritative.

generations.name: Living Digital Commons
generations.goal: People, organizations, communities and projects share reusable digital capabilities without surrendering sovereignty, with durable public-interest governance and sustainable economics.

sustainability.defaultCostRule: prefer free or low fixed-cost tiers when they meet measured reliability and security needs
sustainability.capacityRule: optimize architecture and workload shape before increasing paid capacity
sustainability.revenueRule: paid capacity may expand after recurring revenue, committed funding or demonstrated operational value can support the incremental cost
sustainability.securityException: security, legal, privacy, backup and availability requirements may justify paid capacity before direct revenue

scaleTiers.name: Seed
rules: free or lowest safe tier first
shared database/storage namespaces where isolation permits

scaleTiers.name: Validated
scaleTiers.economics: repeat usage or early recurring revenue
entryEvidence: revenue or committed funding supports incremental cost
rules: increase limits or capacity before service extraction when practical
add targeted observability and cost budgets

scaleTiers.name: Growth
scaleTiers.economics: material recurring revenue or mission-critical usage
entryEvidence: shared runtime is a measured bottleneck
dedicated data/storage improves security or reliability
capacity expansion has positive or justified unit economics
rules: dedicated worker/service boundaries allowed with evidence
regional or provider redundancy considered where justified

scaleTiers.name: Scale
scaleTiers.economics: large sustainable revenue, committed institutional funding or critical public-interest operation
entryEvidence: large sustained traffic or data scale
rules: capacity reservations or enterprise contracts require explicit economic and governance review

newIndependentDeploymentRequiresAny: independent lifecycle required by verified external contract
requiredEvidence: funding or revenue basis when applicable
boundaryCreationGate.existingBoundaryAction: review for convergence before expansion; do not split further without passing the gate

workspaceConvergence.rule: legacy Space surfaces may remain compatibility aliases during migration but must not create a second identity, authority or public routing model

requirements: security and authorization remain centralized and auditable
rollback and degraded operation are defined
promotionRule.authority: EKODI Platform Super Administrator through constitutional change control
